description: report.rs:163 — self.findings.iter().any(|f| f.is_finding()) uses a closure that is an exact method-call wrapper. clippy::redundant_closure_for_method_calls fires. Fix: replace with self.findings.iter().any(Finding::is_finding). One-character ergonomic change, no semantic difference.
title: [rusty/pkix-lint] redundant closure in EvaluationReport::has_findings
